'''June 2001 St. Louis tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament on 16 June 2001. [[Norman Horn]] won it. It is known from Norman Horn's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2479">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-18-norm-strikes-back-6-16-01d2479/ norm-strikes-back-6-16-01], DeckTech (Norman "Norman" Horn, 18 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-18-norm-strikes-back-6-16-01d2479/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 16 June 2001
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Players:''' 10
* '''Winner:''' [[Norman Horn]]
